svg.title: Actual archived Run 1 OOC particle-processing example
svg.desc: Four panels show the verified real raw frame 51 final TIFF page, an enhanced frame and particle mask from the historical v5 output archive, and independent mask-component centroids superimposed on the raw image. A diagnostic count series covers 100 historical masks. This is NOT a v5.2 rerun and does not establish pixelwise agreement with v5.2.
